review_comment: The deepMixin function recursively merges objects without validating property names, allowing external input with '__proto__' or 'constructor' keys to modify Object.prototype. The recursive call enables deep nesting of prototype-polluting properties. Add key validation in the copy function to reject '__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype', and other prototype-polluting property names before assignment.

The deepMixin function allows untrusted property names from source objects to be directly assigned to the target object via 'this[key] = value' without validation. This enables prototype pollution when keys like '__proto__' or 'constructor.prototype' are used. Add property name validation before assignment to reject or sanitize prototype-polluting keys.
